abstract: Gestational choriocarcinoma frequently presents diagnostic difficulties as the first symptoms are often due to distant metastases, particularly to the lung. A case of choriocarcinoma is described; the main features were thyrotoxicosis and a solitary metastasis in the lung arising from a clinically normal uterus. It is emphasized that clinical evaluation of the uterus is unreliable in the diagnosis of choriocarcinoma, a disease which must always be suspected in females with atypical thyrotoxicosis.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌は、主症状が遠隔転移、特に肺転移であることが多く、診断に困難を伴うことがしばしばある。非典型的な甲状腺中毒症と、臨床的に正常な子宮から生じた肺の単発転移を主徴とした絨毛癌の症例を報告する。絨毛癌の診断において、子宮の臨床的評価は信頼性が低いことを強調する。非典型的な甲状腺中毒症を示す女性では、本疾患を必ず疑うべきである。
